items.text:
I LOVE THIS GAME
too bad it's half unplayable due to bugs.
Items disappear. Game will freeze. You will need to re-load to get characters to move and behave normally (often). You will lose employees as they disappear under your ship. You will appear in the abyss.

If it weren't for gamebreaking bugs, this would quickly be my favorite game. I've put in enough hours now anyway, just trying, TRYING, to get some milk from this cow. I loved it, but...

DO NOT BUY THIS GAME AS IT IS. 
If you survive long enough, you will delete your save due to bugs.

it makes me so dang sad :(
items.text_zh:
我爱这款游戏
可惜由于bug，它有一半没法玩。
物品会消失。游戏会卡死。你将需要重新加载才能让角色移动并正常行动（经常如此）。你会失去员工，因为他们消失在你船下。你会出现在深渊中。

如果不是因为那些破坏游戏的bug，这会很快成为我最喜欢的游戏。反正我现在已经投入了足够多的时间，只是试着、试着从这头牛身上挤出一点奶。我爱它，但是……

不要按现状购买这款游戏。
如果你活得够久，你会因为bug而删除你的存档。

这让我难过死了 :(
